content.short: xRocket is a Telegram crypto wallet with storage, swaps, P2P exchange, trading, cheques, invoices, and payments.
content.description: xRocket brings wallet and trading tools directly into Telegram. Users can store crypto, send transfers, create cheques and invoices, accept payments through xRocket Pay, use P2P exchange features, and trade without leaving the Telegram-based flow. xRocket provides secure management of crypto assets directly in Telegram: wallet, P2P exchange, and trading platform. Manage Cryptocurrency via the xRocket Telegram Bot. The experience is organized around features, benefits, products, and information.
